hook: Notice who stopped clapping when you started winning.
full_script: Notice who stopped clapping when you started winning. People love supporting you when you are struggling because your pain reassures their superiority. They will happily play the mentor while you stay beneath them. The moment you ascend higher than the pedestal they built for you, their encouragement turns into whispered contempt. A Kingmaker rarely accepts becoming a subject. The knife that cuts the deepest is never held by a stranger. It is wielded by the ally who believed they owned your future. Build your empire with those who celebrate your throne, not those who demand rent for helping you lay the bricks.
